layout_sources: https://pypi.org/project/beancountswedbank/ 1.0.1 importer.py (first line "* Transaktioner Period <from> ? <to> Skapad <date> <time> <zone>", then the header Radnummer,Clearingnummer,Kontonummer,Produkt,Valuta,Bokföringsdag,Transaktionsdag,Valutadag,Referens,Beskrivning,Belopp,Bokfört saldo; comma-separated; read as iso-8859-15; dates %Y-%m-%d)
https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [SE Swedbank 2020] (file name Transaktioner_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.csv, 2 header rows, %Y-%m-%d, 12 columns)
notes: Swedbank internet bank "Exportera till Excel" CSV. One line above the table ("* Transaktioner Period ... Skapad ..."), then the header. Comma-separated, Windows-1252 (one byte for ö and the en dash in the first line; the importer reads iso-8859-15), CRLF. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; Belopp signed with a point decimal and no thousands mark; "Bokfört saldo" is the balance after each line; Radnummer 1 is the newest line (newest first). Referens and Beskrivning quoted (assumed; the quoting of the other fields is not confirmed). Card lines have a Transaktionsdag a day before the Bokföringsdag; the expected date is the Bokföringsdag (the booking the balance follows). Closing = the newest line's balance; opening = the oldest line's balance minus its amount.
